{{Quote|We were strong&hellip;We were nothing to the Yuuzhan Vong.|Arbeloa|<ref name="Invasion0-1">[[Invasion 0|''Invasion'' 0]]</ref>}}
A '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vonak]] occurred between the [[Cilare (species)|Cilare]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] took place around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], prior to the [[Battle of Artorias]].

==Background==
{{Quote|We were warriors&hellip;we were brutal, we were ruthless. Our children were taught to fight from the moment they could stand.|Arbeloa|<ref name="Invasion0-1" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] launched an invasion of the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]]. In an attempt to pin down the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Ooglith masquer|undercover]] Yuuzhan Vong operatives had infiltrated and stirred trouble on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] and [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]]. Meanwhile, the main fleet invaded and seized several [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]], [[Destrillion]] and [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], thereby forcing the Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] into retreat.

In isolation to these developments, the [[Cilare (species)|Cilare]] people continued their low-tech and warlike existence on Vonak. A warlike people, they instilled martial values in their children while their [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] disdained medicines in favor of war matériel. They believed themselves to be strong and impregnable to any threat. However, this was soon proven to be folly.

==The Battle==
Following the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]], a potent Yuuzhan Vong invasion force landed on their world and waged war on the warrior species. Despite the valor and arsenal of the assembled indigenous army which deployed [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], they were easily wiped out by the onslaught of [[Fire Breather]]s. These deadly war beasts had flexible proboscises that spewed streams of gelatinous flame and pores that exhaled anti-[[Laser/Legends|laser]] aerosols.

[[File:WarArmy.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The assembled warrior army]]

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Abandon your world. Our great strength could not save us&mdash;could not save our loved ones. Learn from our mistake. Don't share our fate. Run.|Arbeloa|<ref name="Invasion0-1" />}}
The Cilare were quickly exterminated as the Yuuzhan Vong pacified their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Only one warrior male, [[Arbeloa]], survived to tell the story and he was taken captive aboard a Yuuzhan Vong [[slaveship]] [[Heart of Artorias|''Tsam P'ah'']]. During his captivity, he was still able to transmit a signal into space which was eventually picked up by the two-men crew of the exploratory ship ''[[Pythea]]''&mdash;the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Panha]] and her [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Sarkkin]]. Having intercepted the signal, the warrior related the nature and culture of his species before going to warn them of the depredations of the Yuuzhan Vong.

Arbeloa's people had been devastated in the attack; he urged recipients of the message to flee the oncoming Yuuzhan Vong invasion force while they still could, as attempting to fight the species was futile. Given that Panha's species, the Chiss, had fought the Yuuzhan Vong before, she understood the nature of their threat to the galaxy. Picking up the presence of a Yuuzhan Vong fleet near them in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], they powered up the ''Phythea'' and fled to the nearest world Artorias in an attempt to warn the Artorians.

However, they were pursued by Yuuzhan Vong vessels. The Chiss explorer attempted to communicated with the [[Artorias communications center]] but the message was intercepted by an [[Unidentified Artorias Yuuzhan Vong agent|advance infiltrator]] who ensured that it did not get through to the public. After fighting off a Yuuzhan Vong boarding party, the two friends agreed they would not face capture and drove their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] into the prow of the Yuuzhan Vong cruiser, immolating themselves and their vessel.

Later, Arbeloa joined forces with the Artorian princess [[Kaye Galfridian]] and other [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to revolt against the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Sha'kel]].
